Tom Kmiec.subject: Health & Medicine
Tom Kmiec.question: Kmiec has repeatedly called for a full parliamentary review of the B-20 _____, that was introduced by the Liberal government in January 2018
Tom Kmiec.fact: Kmiec has repeatedly called for a full parliamentary review of the B-20 Mortgage Stress Test, that was introduced by the Liberal government in January 2018. The Mortgage Stress Test is estimated to have prevented 100,000 Canadians from purchasing a home, slowed mortgage growth by nearly 12 percent, and will delete some 200,000 jobs from the economy by 2021.
